Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including breast carcinoma (multiple); carcinoma (multiple); and hematologic cancer (multiple). WB_Overview: Involved in several processes, including response to anesthetic; response to ethanol; and response to toluene. Located in axon.
